🤝 Sony just locked in a new marketing partnership for The Witcher 4 — and it sounds a lot like the GTA 6 playbook.

CD Projekt Red's CFO Piotr Nielubowicz told investors the studio has signed new terms with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering CDPR's games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus, plus direct collaboration on The Witcher 4's upcoming marketing campaign. He stopped short of confirming exclusivity, but the first Witcher 4 footage already debuted on PS5 — echoing Sony's aggressive "Plays Best on PS5" push for GTA 6.

🕐 Published: 03:57 GMT+3, Nov 25, 2026
📰 Sources: Push Square, Wolf's Gaming Blog
👥 x.com/CDPROJEKTRED, x.com/PlayStation
